component.name: Clippy Pet
component.summary: An unofficial animated paperclip Codex pet

description.p: Clippy Pet is an unofficial, Codex-compatible v2 animated pet inspired by the visual language of classic late-1990s desktop assistants. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
Installing Clippy Pet copies its manifest and spritesheet into your Codex configuration directory so the ChatGPT desktop app (Codex) and Codex CLI TUI can offer it as a selectable pet.
